title: Contribute a harness injection definition
statement: As a harness author or integration contributor, I can contribute a harness injection definition through a pull request so other consumers can select the same settings from the bundled Cordyceps registry.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A contributor can submit the injection definition and relevant library-level examples or tests through the contribution path; no installed-binary certification or executable-version support matrix is required.
After acceptance and release, consumers select the bundled definition through the same registry and injection API used for local definitions.
